brief: A fashion-first sleepwear label for people who want what they wear to bed to be as considered as what they wear to dinner. Six colourways, XS–4X, wash-tested fabrics.
criteria: Success: distinct from sleepwear clichés, recognisable at 16px, works in one colour, feels premium without being loud.

concepts.name: Monogram
concepts.idea: A serif E/T ligature in a disc — the initial of the word that distinguishes this label.
rationale: Ownable: no other sleepwear brand uses an E/T monogram
Legible at favicon size thanks to the disc frame
The E and T share a spine — two ideas in one mark
